body:
**EvoTools**
EvoTools is a progression-based Minecraft plugin that adds 5 evolutive tools and weapons, each with a full leveling system, custom enchantments, and unique abilities. Give your players a reason to keep grinding — every block mined, mob killed, and crop harvested pushes their tools further.

Features
Evolutive Items
Five progression items, each leveling from 1 to 100:

⚔️ Evolutionary Sword
⛏️ Evolutionary Pickaxe
🪓 Evolutionary Axe
🌾 Evolutionary Hoe
🪣 Evolutionary Shovel
Each item gains XP through its specific actions (kills, mining, chopping, harvesting, digging), unlocks new power tiers, and changes name color as it evolves — from gray all the way to red.

Prestige System
After reaching max level, players can prestige up to 5 times for even greater power, earning custom prefixes and stacking bonuses on top of their level progression.

50+ Custom Enchantments
Every tool has 10 unique enchantments with multiple levels:

Sword — Ignition, Bleeding, Vampirism, Execution, Riposte, Stolen Soul, Storm, and more

Pickaxe — Veinminer, Prospector, Fusion (auto-smelt), Seismic (ore radar), Magnetism, Explosion, and more

Axe — Forester (fell entire trees), Whirlwind, Shield Breaker, Replantation, Roots, and more

Hoe — Harvest (area reap), Fertilizer, Gardener (area till), Abundance, Germination, and more

Shovel — Excavation, Earthquake, Archaeology, Paver (area path), Burial, and more

HUD & Display
Real-time progression feedback via Action Bar or Boss Bar:

Visual XP progress bar
Current level, prestige rank, and bonuses
Fully configurable display format using MiniMessage
Admin Tools
/evotools give — Grant items to players
/evotools prestige — Manage prestige levels
/evotools admin — In-game admin GUI
/evotools reload — Reload configuration
Configuration
Per-tool YAML configuration files
Customizable XP formulas, lore templates, and level thresholds
MiniMessage color formatting support
Custom model data support for texture packs
Multi-language support
Perfect for survival servers, RPG servers, or any server looking to add a deep, long-term progression system on top of vanilla gameplay.
